title: Ask HN: If you had no limitations what would you build in AI?
description: - You know the field, even you are not a top expert - You know a group of investors that believe in you and will back up your next move. - Your idea could be implemented with the technology that exists today or that could exist in a near future - Your project is ambitious, even hight risk but realistic. - Your first move is small and well defined What would you build?
